original_ai_output.title_zh: 拉各斯与奥贡州居民因停电加剧高温而抗议
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚拉各斯州和奥贡州居民抱怨社区长期停电，称停电加剧了高温，夜间难以入睡。拉各斯州索莫卢地区数百名居民周四上街抗议长期停电，要求立即恢复供电。抗议者高喊口号并手持标语，相关视频在网络流传。目前信息仅来自单一来源。

location.raw_text: Somolu, Lagos State; Lagos and Ogun states

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯州和奥贡州居民抱怨长期停电加剧高温
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Some residents of Lagos and Ogun states have lamented prolonged power outages in their communities, saying the situation has worsened the intense heat

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯州索莫卢数百名居民周四上街抗议停电
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: hundreds of residents of Somolu, Lagos State, took to the streets on Thursday to protest the prolonged blackout

key_facts.fact: 抗议者要求立即恢复供电
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: calling for the immediate restoration of electricity

key_facts.fact: 抗议者手持“给我们电”等标语
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: placards bearing inscriptions such as, “Give us light” and “Our businesses are dying.”

uncertainties: 事件仅由单一来源Punch报道，尚未获得交叉验证
抗议规模及是否发生冲突或伤亡尚未证实
